verses.text: yaa rabbanaa salli halaa maahin azaalal wajalaa
muhammadin wa hassilaa maa sarranii wa sallimi
yaa rabbanaa salli halaa khayri siraajinih talaa
muhammadin man ghasalaa maa saa-anii wa sallimi
yaa rabbanaa salli halaa khayri muniirin ursilaa
muhammadin man kamulaa muraaduhu wa sallimi
yaa rabbanaa salli halaa khayri bashiirin nawwalaa
muhammadin man hajjalaa bushaaratii wa sallimi
yaa rabbanaa salli halaa man sabquhu qad huqilaa
muhammadin man akhjalaa qaaliyanii wa sallimi
yaa rabbanaa salli halaa man kasalii qad ghasalaa
muhammadin man bajjalaa qasaa-idii wa sallimi
yaa rabbanaa salli halaa ahqali kullil huqalaa
muhammadin man haqalaa mubaarizii wa sallimi
salli halaa saarin samaa fawqal buraaqi lis samaa
muhammadin wa karrimaa bihizbihi wa sallimi
qad baata yakhriqut tibaaq fil layli qaasida wifaaq
wal anbiyaa-u bit tifaaq laa qawhu bit takarrumi
wahtaramuu wa qaddamuu wa karramuu wastaslamuu
tawaaduhan wa hazzamuu liqadrihil muhtarami
tawaadahuu iz harafuu rutbatahu wa sharrafuu
liqaa-ahuu wahtarafuu bil fadli wat taqaddumi
wabtadaruu bil marhabi was sahli wat ta-addubi
wal bishri wat taqarrubi lirabbihil muqaddimi
wal kullu minhum sharaahaa fii mahmadin iz samihaa
zikra shafiihish shufuhaa mahal amiinil aqdami
wal kullu minhum madahaa min bahdi maa qad farihaa
bibah-sihi wan sharahaa sadran lishukrin nihami
faghaaba hanhum wartaqaa fawqal buraaqi liliqaa
habiibihi wakhtaraqaa hujbal ilaahil muhami
summa lidaa rihinsanaa wa qad hawaa kulla munaa
minhu wa azhabal hanaa wa jaalibaatin niqami
nihman nabiyyu war rasuul nihmal lazii jaada bisuul
lanaa birabbihil jamiil min zikrihi wal laqami
aayaatul taaha ahmadaa laa tatanaahaa sarmadaa
wanat quwaa zawil hudaa han khattihaa bil qalami
arsalahul laahu ilaa kullil waraa murattilaa
zikran halayhi unzilaa hudan lizit tahallumi
akrim bizaalikal kitaab fiihi hudaahu was sawaab
fiihil khitaabu wal jawaab min rabbinaa zil qidami
huwash shifaa min kulli daa liman halayhih tamadaa
wa man abaahu turidaa zaa hasratin wa nadami
wa kullu shakhsin alhadaa fiihi wa lam yajtahidaa
bitawbatin laaqar radaa min rabbihil muntaqimi
wahwal lazii manih tadaa bihad-yihi naala hudaa
wa yahtawil fawza ghadaa zaa hismatin min niqami
wahwal kitaabuhul mubin jaa-a bihin nadbul amiin
bi-izni rabbil haalamiin hudan lihaawil aqwami
wahwal lazii man adbaraa hanhu wa maa taddabaraa
fiihi hasaa rabbal waraa adhuukatan lil luwwami
wahwal lazii man sabataa fiihi wa lam yaltafitaa
zaa hamalin yakun fataa hindash shakuuril akrami
wahwal lazii manik tafaa bihih tawaa maa qad tafaa
walaa yulaaqii kulafaa zawil azaa bil karami
ahmadu rabbiya halaa kitaabihil lazii halaa
kulla kitaabin nuzzilaa bikalkalii wa bil fami
ashkuuru rabbiyal haziim halaa kitaabihil hakiim
wa fuztu fiihi bihuluum tufhimu zaa talaffumi
kitaabu rabbiyal kitaab binassi zaalikal kitaab
bihi husimtu min hitaab wa jaalibaatis saqami
huwa khaliilun wa habiib lii mughniyan lii han tabiib
bihi yuhibbunii labiib yatlubu khayral laqami
yaa khayra zikrin nuzzilaa min khayri rabbin anzalaa
liya taquudu nuzulaa  min zil baaqa wal qidami
yaa khayra zikrin qad badaa mimman safaa-ii abbadaa
lii khallidanna raghadaa zaa amanin wa khidami
anta rafiiqii lil jinaan yaa man yasuunu lil makaan
wa lii tutayyibul janaan yaa khayra zikrin muhkami
yaa khayra zikrin ruttilaa bifami zaakirin talaa
suq lisiwaaya man qalaa wa liya kun wa hakkimi
yaa khayra munzilin yurii maa ghaaba zaa tadabburi
rabbii yusaffii fikarii bika bighayri tuhami
yaa khayra zikrin qad jamah khayral huluumi wa qamah
liya hidaaya wa manah minnii azaa tawahhumi
anta sabiilii wal aniis lii qudtta faa-iqal maqiis
bikhidmatil maahir ra-is mukayyisii bil mulhimi
yaa khayra zikrin qad mahaa maasaa-a qalbii faammahaa
hab liya kawnii muflihaa bil munzilil mufahhimi
bika sa-altu maalikii kawniya nuura saaliki
wa zan jizaabin naasiki biman jalaa wal mubhami
wa an yaquuda lin nabii fii abadin bin nukhubi
salaamayil muqarribi bilan tihan wal makhtami
